limitations: Declarative routing intentionally requires the GameData path, Catalog XML root, and an enclosing SC2 mod, map, or campaign artifact; the bounded detector remains the structural authority after prefiltering.
Catalog loading and inheritance resolution are only as complete as the ordered GameContentResolver chain supplied by the host.

edit.content covers schema-driven catalog entity rename only. Each edited GameData file is rebuilt from its parsed entries, so XML comments and original formatting are normalized rather than preserved; the operation refuses when one entity id is declared in more than one loaded file, and degrades to dependency-required when the inheritance chain is incomplete.
export.convert emits catalog JSON or per-namespace GameData XML; mod-level packaging (ComponentList.SC2Components, locale strings files, opaque-file round-trip) stays with the mod domain.
Override-layer comparison and entity-card assembly remain disabled in the current facade.
Browser runtime reachability is not declared because the current catalog and language-analysis import graph reaches unresolved vscode-languageserver-protocol submodules.
StarCraft II game contribution metadata remains on the semantic codec until game manifests land in Slice C3.
